slides.label: Verse 1
lines: The living Word, Dear Lord Jesus
You are the greatest treasure of all
The truth and life, incorruptible
Faithful for all time with an unfailing love

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: You are our wisdom
You are our joy, our strength and delight

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: The King of Glory
Radiant beyond words can describe

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: The living Word, You are all-powerful
You rule the nations of the earth
No throne or power can contend
Your word is law, unbreakable
The binding force that holds all things in place
